original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Avoid repeated rational matrix subtraction and hashing for identical ordered frame pairs within one inspect_candidate call, preserving complete exact receipts.
scope_change_reason: OS seed 87 assigns verification engineering; measured existing finite-bit fixtures identify repeated transition construction as the chosen bottleneck.
bottleneck_link: This historical exact checker serves finite-bit candidate audits. Reducing duplicate transition work improves review throughput without changing supplier or theorem assumptions.
stop_rule: One source-pinned optimization; implementation stops by 03:27 UTC and handoff by 03:37 UTC on 2026-10-14. At most nine fresh-process benchmark pairs, no search for a better bound.
evidence: verify.py compares all complete receipts, eleven rejection controls and between-call mutation; 53 existing tests per engine. BENCHMARK.json records alternating fresh-process same-input timings.
author: Sagar Thakrar (thakrarsagar)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with profiling, code, verification, analysis and writing. No independent human review claimed.
